text:
Vik: heads-up — customer reported broken anchor from our blog: https://redwood.ai/migrate-v1 -> it links to /docs/migration/v1.2-migration-guide#upgrade-path but deploy linkcheck says fragment not found.
Carmen: ugh. do we have the heading in that page? could be slugification of the dotted version (v1.2) vs link expecting the dot.
RenderBot: linkcheck error: page=docs/migration/v1-2.md fragment=upgrade-path status=404 run=CI#17201
Vik: the page top looks like this in source:
```
## v1.2 Migration guide

### Upgrade path

Follow these steps to move from v1.x to v2.x...
```
Ethan: mkdocs/docusaurus slugifiers typically strip punctuation, so `v1.2` -> `v12-migration-guide` while external links used the literal `v1.2-migration-guide`. That mismatch would break anchors.
Carmen: so two fixes: 1) add an explicit header id to the heading so the slug is stable, e.g.
```
## v1.2 Migration guide {#v1.2-migration-guide}
```
but not all renderers allow dots in explicit ids; safer is `{#v1-2-migration-guide}` and then add redirects. 2) add a redirect that maps the old dotted path/anchor to the new one.
DocsEng: agree on safe implicit id. Also note: we should avoid changing the canonical URL for the page if possible; add a short redirects/aliases frontmatter block instead. Example for docusaurus frontmatter:
```
---
slug: /docs/migration/v1-2-migration-guide
aliases:
  - /docs/migration/v1.2-migration-guide
---
```
Ethan: that preserves existing inbound links and avoids breaking SEO.
Vik: I'll do a small PR that (a) adds an explicit simple id to the heading `{#v1-2-migration-guide}` and (b) adds an aliases entry pointing from the dotted variant to the new slug. I'll also ping marketing to update the blog link if they prefer the non-dotted path.
RenderBot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4477 by @vik  CI queued
Carmen: minor nit — in CONTRIBUTING.md let's add a note: "Prefer version headings without punctuation for stable anchors, or explicitly set an id and add aliases when migrating old links." Saves repeat.
DocsEng: also let's add a docs-ops task to scan for headings containing version-like patterns (\bv\d+\.\d+\b) and suggest canonical ids. DOCS-560 created.
Ethan: once PR lands, can someone run a quick crawl to validate the alias works and that external blog links resolve with anchors? I can smoke-test with a curl + fragment check (follow redirects).
RenderBot: CI passed for PR #4477  All checks green.
Carmen: LGTM, merged. I added a tiny follow-up commit to CONTRIBUTING.md describing the version-heading pattern.
Vik: pinged marketing to update the blog to the alias-free path. Marketing replied that they'll update later this week; in the meantime aliases cover it.
DocsEng: closing here — we have explicit id, alias, contributor note, and a follow-up scan ticket. Reopen if any more broken anchors show up. :white_check_mark:
